user.title: Connect to Aquastilla
user.description: Sign in with the e-mail address and password of your Aquastilla app account. Signing in with Google, Apple or Facebook cannot be used here: set a password for the account with the app's password reset first.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved password for {email} was rejected. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: The e-mail address or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: The Aquastilla service could not be reached. Try again later.
error.no_devices: This account has no device. Add the softener in the Aquastilla app first.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That password belongs to a different account.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks the Aquastilla service for new data. The service belongs to the vendor, so five minutes is the default and fresher data is not available by asking more often.

data_description.enable_device_management: Registers the pair and remove actions. Both cannot be undone.

device_detached.title: {name} is no longer on the Aquastilla account
device_detached.description: The Aquastilla service reports that this device is no longer attached to the account. It may have been removed in the Aquastilla app, or the account has changed. Its entities are unavailable and Home Assistant stops asking for it. The integration checks again once an hour, so it comes back by itself if the device is attached again. Removing the integration never deletes anything on the service.

close_water_flow.name: Close the water flow (cannot be undone remotely)

blocked_service_mode.message: The device is in remote service mode and does not accept this command.

blocked_water_flow_closed.message: The water flow is closed, so the device does not accept this command.

blocked_regenerating.message: A regeneration is running, so the device does not accept this command.

blocked_vacation_mode.message: Vacation mode is on, so a regeneration cannot be forced or postponed.

command_pending.message: The same command is still waiting for the device to confirm it.

command_failed.message: The command could not be sent: {error}

settings_unknown.message: The device's current settings are not known yet, so this value cannot be changed.

default_device_cannot_be_cleared.message: A device stops being the default only when another one is made the default.

blocked_offline.message: The device is offline, so this command is refused: the cloud would keep it and carry it out whenever the device comes back.

rename_device.name: Rename device
rename_device.description: Renames the device at the vendor. Home Assistant picks up the new name after the next device list read.

start_remote_service.name: Start remote service
start_remote_service.description: Gives the vendor's service access to the device for a number of hours. While it runs, the owner controls are locked.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How long the access lasts, 1 to 23.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on. This grants a third party access.

end_remote_service.name: End remote service
end_remote_service.description: Ends the remote service access to the device.

pair_device.name: Pair device
pair_device.description: Attaches a device to the account with its pairing code. Only available when device management is switched on in the options.

code.name: Code
code.description: The pairing code of the device.

delete_device.name: Remove device
delete_device.description: Removes the device from the account. This cannot be undone, and the stored statistics of the device go with it. Only available when device management is switched on in the options.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on. This cannot be undone.
